overview: Grieg’s Sanctum is the final chamber before the Mindcore.
details: Here, Grieg’s genius and madness merge. His architectural mastery is visible in floating sigils and impossible structures, while his psychic collapse manifests as hostile echoes and void distortions. The Architect’s Echo rules the Sanctum.
hooks: A floating sigil cracks, releasing void energy.
An echo of Grieg speaks in fragmented sentences.
The Sanctum shifts, rearranging its architecture.
The Architect’s Echo awakens to defend the chamber.
